 WASHINGTON (AP) - Republican Glenn Grothman wins reelection to U.S. House in Wisconsin's 6th Congressional District.
 This is a breaking news story and will be updated. 
 -----
 (WLUK) -- Republican U.S. Rep. Glenn Grothman is looking to fend off Democrat challenger Brad Smith as Wisconsin's representative from the 6th Congressional District.
 Grothman, 71, is seeking his seventh term, while Smith is seeking his first political office. Grothman served in the state legislature from 1993-2015.
 The district heavily favors Republicans, electing Grothman with a 23-point margin in 2024. No Democrat has represented this district since John Abner Race from 1965-67, and no statewide or nationwide candidate has won the district since President Barack Obama in 2008, who won by 0.05%.
 Grothman considers his priorities to be cleaning up the welfare system and protecting family values, protecting laws that support employers employing people with disabilities and supporting manufacturing.
 Smith's priorities revolve around the rising price of fuel and cost of living and protecting jobs and the economy.
 FOX 11 will update this story as we learn the results of tonight's race.
